invoicing.policy: Invoicing 2.23.0 preserves the completed billing product, verified merchant payment connections, customer Pay Now, M-PESA STK/C2B reconciliation, truthful webhook health, and provider-authoritative refunds. Provider-backed payments retain their original refundable transaction identity. Stripe, PayPal, Paystack and Flutterwave refunds remain pending until provider status proves completion; Pesapal accepted requests require explicit merchant completion confirmation because API acceptance is not settlement. Pending/requires_action/failed refunds do not reduce financial balances or post Accounting; only finalized posted refunds do. M-PESA reversal remains intentionally manual until Daraja initiator/security credentials are implemented. Completed external refunds cannot be reversed internally. The release gate includes 71+ Invoicing/payment/refund regressions, Accounting parity, quality locks, migrations, responsive/app UI, ERP integration, TypeScript and production build.
